newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: ICE HOCKEY-CZECHS, CANADA TIED 2-2 AFTER 1ST PERIOD.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-CZECHS, CANADA TIED 2-2 AFTER 1ST PERIOD.

text.p: The Czech Republic and Canada were tied 2-2 after the first period in their World ice hockey medal round matchup in Helsinki on Wednesday.
Canada opened the scoring when Czech defenceman Jiri Vykoukal accidentally kicked the puck into his own goal early in the period.
But the Czechs fought back and took the lead on the power play when Vladimir Vujtek put the puck into an open net after a perfect cross-ice pass from Martin Prochazka.
Prochazka then put the Czechs up 2-1 when he tipped a centering pass by Canadian netminder Sean Burke.
Canada evened the score, however, when Rob Zamuner scored his second goal of the game -- he was credited with the first goal -- with five minutes left in the period.
The Czechs must win the game if they hope to have a chance of continuing into the best-of-three final series.
